title: Beyond Truncation? Entailment-Licensed Elision and the Limits of Semantic Preservation in LLM Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.08975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) answer at greater length than a request needs. We ask whether a training-free controller inside the decoding loop can remove that surplus while preserving content, judged against the simplest possible baseline: truncating the model's own answer to the same length. An entropy-gated logits processor removes 25.5-34.9% of tokens on MT-Bench development questions and 19.9-34.2% on a sealed test split within pre-registered BERTScore non-inferiority margins, yet we prove and confirm by audit that its output is always a prefix of the unmodified answer: the saving is truncation. A survey of 23 training-free mechanism families finds none that selects content better than truncation without oracle labels. We therefore introduce Entailment-Licensed In-Decoding Elision (ELIDE), which, at each sentence boundary, withholds a span from the reader only when a natural-language inference model judges it entail

translated_title: 超越截断？蕴含许可的省略与LLM解码中语义保持的极限
translated_abstract: 指令微调的大型语言模型（LLM）的回答长度往往超过请求的实际需要。我们探究在解码循环内部加入一个免训练的控制器能否在保持内容的前提下去除这些冗余，并以最简单的基线作为评判标准：将模型自身的回答截断到相同长度。一个基于熵门控的logits处理器在MT-Bench开发问题上删除了25.5%-34.9%的词元，在密封测试集上删除了19.9%-34.2%的词元，且均落在预先注册的BERTScore非劣性边界之内；然而我们通过理论证明和审计确认，其输出始终是未修改回答的前缀：所谓的节省本质上就是截断。对23个免训练机制族的调研发现，在没有oracle标签的情况下，没有任何机制能比截断更好地选择内容。因此，我们提出了蕴含许可的解码中省略（ELIDE），它在每个句子边界处，仅当自然语言推理模型判定该片段可由所保留内容蕴含时，才向读者隐去该片段……
tldr: 该论文证明了现有免训练的解码期冗余删除方法本质上都只是截断，并提出ELIDE方法，利用自然语言推理模型在每个句子边界判断被删内容是否被保留内容所蕴含，从而实现真正超越截断的语义保持式回答精简。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that existing training-free decoding-time redundancy removal is fundamentally just truncation, and proposes ELIDE, which elides sentence spans only when a natural language inference model certifies they are entailed by the retained context, achieving semantic-preserving brevity beyond truncation.
